# gyro_service_label (Resource)

Nickname and colour tags of any existing service (cloud server, container environment, VDS, storage, DNS, mail, ...). The nickname is shown as the service title in the client area (the product name and service number stay below it) and is returned by gyro_services. This resource owns the whole label: destroying it clears the nickname and all tags. Only the service owner sees the label (staff see it read only).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Give any service a nickname and colour tags. The nickname becomes the service title in the
# client area; the product name and service number stay below it.
resource "gyro_server" "api" {
  plan          = "standart-2-4"
  region        = "tr-ist-1"
  image         = "ubuntu-24.04"
  confirm_order = true
}

resource "gyro_service_label" "api" {
  service_id = tonumber(gyro_server.api.id)
  nickname   = "api-gateway"
  tags = [
    { name = "production", color = "green" },
    { name = "api" }, # colour omitted: a stable default is chosen by the API
  ]
}

# An existing service (e.g. a container environment) by its number.
resource "gyro_service_label" "ecs" {
  service_id = 12345
  nickname   = "gyro-ecs-1"
  tags       = [{ name = "staging", color = "orange" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Service id (gyro_services, gyro_server.id, client area #number). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `nickname` (String) 1-60 characters, e.g. "api-gateway". Omit to keep the service without a nickname.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Up to 10 tags, kept in this order. Names are case-insensitively unique. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as service_id.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `name` (String) 1-24 characters: letter or digit first, then letters, digits, space and . _ - / + # &.

Optional:

- `color` (String) One of [gray blue green red orange yellow purple pink teal indigo]; omitted = a stable default chosen by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_service_label.ecs 12345
```
